description: This MCP server's own call log and outbound event subscription. trace reads the audit trace (open mode needs no key). activity (admin) reads the activity file shown on /log. export (admin) returns counters, recent errors, and the audit trace. server_log with action generate_traffic makes a few safe read calls and needs any credential. events reads the subscription; the MQTT password is not returned. configure (admin) sets realtime or a 5-minute interval, whether push is allowed, and MQTT. push sends one line now when that is allowed, on GET /events, legacy SSE, Streamable HTTP, and MQTT. Call get_schema with name server_log for every action's fields.

action.description: trace: Read recent audit-trace rows. Not admin. | activity: Admin. Read recent activity-file rows. | export: Admin. Return counters, recent errors, and the trace. | server_log with action generate_traffic: Make rounds of safe read calls. | events: Read the event subscription. The MQTT password is not returned. | configure: Admin. Set realtime or a 5-minute interval, Allow server_log with action push, and MQTT. Omit mqtt_password to keep it. | push: Send one line now when Allow server_log with action push is on. Needs line.

mode.description: realtime sends each line immediately. interval buffers trace lines for 5 minutes. server_log with action push still sends immediately.

mqtt_enabled.description: When true, publish the same JSON to the MQTT broker.

mqtt_password.description: Broker password. Stored on this machine and never returned. Omit to keep the current password.

mqtt_url.description: Broker URL, mqtt://host:1883 or mqtts://host:8883. A password in the URL is stored and removed from the URL.

mqtt_username.description: Broker username. Omit to keep the current username.

push_log_allowed.description: When true, server_log with action push may send a line now.

name: server_log
